description: Semi-global (fitting) pairwise alignment with affine gap costs: sequence1 is aligned end to end inside sequence2 (free leading/trailing sequence2 residues); a gap of length k scores gapOpen + k·gapExtend. Equals Biopython PairwiseAligner(mode='global', end_insertion_score=0) and parasail sg_dx. startPosition2/endPosition2 report the fitted interval of sequence2 (0-based inclusive; the free flanks lie outside it; an empty interval has endPosition2 = startPosition2 - 1); startPosition1/endPosition1 span the whole query. With matrix = BLOSUM62 | PAM250 | EDNAFULL the alignment is scored by that published residue-pair table (protein or IUPAC DNA, any symbol of the matrix) instead of match/mismatch and gapOpen/gapExtend may be fractional (EMBOSS needle/water 6.6.0 = Biopython PairwiseAligner = parasail on >1000 oracle rows; EMBOSS -gapopen G -gapextend E = gapOpen -(G - E), gapExtend -E); exactScore is then the real-valued score (score = rounded). Matrix mode accepts protein sequences (no DNA validation).

gapOpen.description: Gap-open score added once per gap run (negative = penalty). May be fractional when matrix is given; EMBOSS gapopen G / gapextend E = gapOpen -(G - E), gapExtend -E.

gapExtend.description: Gap score per gap position, in addition to gapOpen for the first one. May be fractional (e.g. -0.5) when matrix is given.

matrix.description: Optional substitution matrix: BLOSUM62, PAM250 (protein) or EDNAFULL (IUPAC DNA). When given, match/mismatch are ignored, residues are scored by the published table (any protein or IUPAC symbol of the matrix; case-insensitive) and gapOpen/gapExtend may be fractional (the EMBOSS needle/water models: gapOpen = -(G - E), gapExtend = -E for -gapopen G -gapextend E). The result then also carries the real-valued exactScore.

startPosition2.description: First sequence2 index consumed by the alignment (fitted-interval start = number of free leading reference residues).

endPosition2.description: Last sequence2 index consumed by the alignment (fitted-interval end); an empty interval has endPosition2 = startPosition2 - 1.

exactScore.description: Real-valued score (equals score for integer scoring; with matrix/fractional gaps score is this value rounded half away from zero).
